gloss_en: The awareness that all of one's experiences/happenings (me'ora'ot) are for one's good — the state of knowing this, taught in Likutey Moharan I:4 to be a foretaste of the World to Come, expressed in blessing 'HaTov veHaMeitiv' on everything without distinguishing kindness from judgment
canonical_he: כשאדם יודע שכל מארעותיו הם לטובתו
